source.note: Archive AMIKO MINI COMBO EXTRA Edision_v.1515.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_v1515_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_v1515_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs at 0x9FE00800, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 107 / 110, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("6A000A001515", 11.40 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko Mini Combo Extra (System ID 6A000A00) firmware 1.5.15 Edision (2020-12-4) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3526C / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses the 256 MB DDR remap (0xB8000220 bit 24, SEE at 0xAE000200), a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
